name: v0.3.5 — engagement-strip horizontal scroll
releaseNotes:
• Engagement strip (GuacScore · GuacWizard · GuacMoney · Rewards) becomes one horizontal-scroll carousel matching the web dashboard.
• Tap any tile → routes to its detail screen (GuacScore → /guacanomics, GuacWizard → /guacwizard, GuacMoney → /shopping, Rewards → /rewards).
• In-app update detector switched from GitHub Releases to a manifest at getguac.app/downloads/latest.json so new builds are detected the moment they ship.
• Push-notification scaffolding (Firebase Cloud Messaging) — token captured on sign-in; daily server-side dispatcher pending Vercel env-var setup.
